welcome.title: Welcome to the CodeBuddies world
welcome.text: This is your space to learn programming by playing with others. We'll show you the important bits in 1 minute.

move.title: Moving around
move.text: Click the floor to walk. Use the mouse wheel or the zoom buttons to get closer or further.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.text: Your level, XP and coins. What you earn here and on the web adds to the same level.

pc.title: The PC and CodeStudio
pc.text: Open the PC to enter CodeStudio: found your own startup, build your app and learn how real software is made.

customize.title: Your avatar
customize.text: Change your clothes, hair and style whenever you want.

shop.title: Shop
shop.text: Furniture, clothes and effects with your coins. Wearables are personal: one per person, or gift it to a friend.

friends.title: Friends
friends.text: Add friends, chat with them, visit their rooms and send them gifts.

missions.title: Missions
missions.text: Daily challenges with rewards. Check here how much you have left.

chat.title: Chat and reactions
chat.text: Write to people in your room or react with one click.

end.title: Let's play!
end.text: We recommend starting with CodeStudio: it has a step-by-step guide for total beginners.
